video_title: Basketball LEGEND Nikos Galis SURPRISES Giannis, Kostas & Alex Antetokounmpo LIVE in Athens, Greece

quotes.speaker: Nikos Galis
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikos Galis on playing against Michael Jordan
quotes.excerpt: I remember this game. I was with the national team and Michael was a young boy.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: I was looking at this box score and it was a game that you played against Michael Jordan. And you had 26 points and he had 30 something. You guys were going head-to-head. I don't think they understand what this means. Do you remember which game this was?

text_blocks.speaker: Nikos Galis
text_blocks.text: I remember this game. I was with the national team and Michael was a young boy at this time. He was playing for North Carolina. But he showed signs even at a young age that he was going to be something special. We played the game, they won. They had a good team that year. They won it that year on a buzzer-beater by Michael. After the game, he came up to me, he gave me his hand and he said, 'Why are you here? Why aren't you in the States? Why aren't you in the NBA?' I said, 'Because I love it here.'

quotes.speaker: Nikos Galis
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikos Galis on the narrowing gap between Europe and the NBA
quotes.excerpt: The gap is narrowed. We can see that. Giannis, Jokic, Lucas. There are great players coming out of Europe.
quotes.quote: The gap is narrowed. We can see that. Giannis, Jokic, Lucas. There are great players coming out of Europe. This was inevitable that it was going to happen. And I'm happy for this, playing in Europe. And I think it's going to continue too. I think it's going to continue. More players are going to come out of Europe. We might see more players from Europe than American players sometimes in the NBA, you never know.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the killer mentality of legendary players
quotes.excerpt: I've had this same feeling with very specific players. I've had this same feeling with Kobe Bryant, Kevin Garnett and you.
quotes.quote: The moment I left the dinner and I got up, I said I've had this same feeling with very specific players. I've never met Michael Jordan, I've shaken his hand. But I've had this same feeling. I had it with Kobe Bryant, Kevin Garnett and you. A feeling of like a killer mentality. And when I got out of the table, I looked at my mom, I looked at my agent and I looked at my brother, I said, 'Now I know why he is who he is.'

quotes.speaker: Nikos Galis
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikos Galis on work ethic and passion for basketball
quotes.excerpt: What I admire in you is your work ethics and your passion for the game.
quotes.quote: What I admire in you is your work ethics and your passion for the game. And I'm sure just like me, you would play for free and play just as hard. Is it true?

quotes.speaker: Nikos Galis
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikos Galis on the necessity of hard work to sustain success
quotes.excerpt: You have to be motivated to put the work in, to put the time in. This doesn't come easy.
quotes.quote: You have to be motivated to put the work in, to put the time in. This doesn't come easy. It's not handed to you. I've seen so many talents come and go. People that could jump higher than me, who can run faster than me, but you have to put the work in. If you don't put the work in, it's going to leave you. Whatever you leave, it'll leave you. So be motivated, be inspired, and be respectful, listen to people who can help you.

quotes.speaker: Nikos Galis
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikos Galis on the mental toughness required to stay at the top
quotes.excerpt: It's easier to get to the top, but it's harder to stay there. So this is where the mind plays a role.
quotes.quote: To be a superstar in my opinion, to be a superstar, it's in here. Because everybody can jump, everybody can run, everybody can shoot, but it's in here. Because you know, it's easier to get to the top, but it's harder to stay there. So this is where the mind plays a role. And you have to be mentally tough, not too high, not too low, and just keep on going, just keep on going.

quotes.speaker: Nikos Galis
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikos Galis on the greatest European players of his era
quotes.excerpt: Petrovic, Sabonis, Toni Kukoc, Divac, so many. Jamchy even from Israel, Dacouri from France.
quotes.quote: Let's remember that the countries were united at that time. United Russia, United Yugoslavia, very strong teams at that time. So many, I don't want to disrespect anybody, but Petrovic, Sabonis, Toni Kukoc, Divac, so many. Jamchy even from Israel, Dacouri from France. There were many great players at that time. And a lot of them went to the NBA too, the Sabonis and Kukoc. Kukoc was a fantastic player.

quotes.speaker: Nikos Galis
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikos Galis on playing for free and the romanticism of the game
quotes.excerpt: I played one year without being paid because the team didn't have money, but I didn't want to stop.
quotes.quote: When I was playing, I played one year without being paid because the team didn't have money, but I didn't want to stop. I didn't want to stop playing. So I continued. It's difficult now to tell a player, 'Don't play if he doesn't get paid.' It's not easy. I understand this. But in my days, we would play like that too, at least I did.

quotes.speaker: Nikos Galis
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikos Galis on his injury-free career and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: In my career I never had a very serious injury. I trained more than anyone else.
quotes.quote: In my career I never had a very serious injury. I had a sprained ankle or something like that, but I trained so hard that I trained more than anyone else. So I never had a serious injury in my life. The way I stopped was a different story, I don't want to get into that now. But I feel I could have played into my 40s easy.

quotes.speaker: George Panou
quotes.summary_phrase: George Panou on the purpose of the foundation and autism awareness
quotes.excerpt: To create a strong awareness for autism and when and also a basketball team with the kids in spectrum.
quotes.quote: Four years ago I had the honor with the help of George Spanou to be the one who united Nikos and Giannis under a very important purpose. What was this purpose? To create a strong awareness for autism and when and also a basketball team with the kids in spectrum, do you recall? Even then my wife and daughter were not ready to say in public that our daughter Arya is in autism spectrum because they were afraid of being stigmatized. So instead of her, I spoke about myself and said that I am in autism spectrum, having Nikos and Giannis by my side in a photo with the three of us.
